text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heeey, Doto! The meat is cooked! Bring out 
the plates, pleeease!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, smells great. Taiki and Doto having a 
barbecue?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
This looks delicious! Hey, let me join in 
on the feast. In exchange, how about some 
souvenir snacks from abroad?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
No problem, drop-ins are super welcome! 
Let's keep grilling more and more!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Haaa... Not just the meat, but the 
vegetables are piping hot and delicious 
too...!!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, we're running low on vegetables. 
Dotou, could you please go bring some more 
from the stock?

text_block_list.name: Passing Goat
text_block_list.text: Baaah~...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh, hello, Mr. Goat? Do you want some 
veggies? Hehe, here you go~.

text_block_list.name: Flock of Animals
text_block_list.text: Baaah, baaah! Meoow~♪ Oink, oink...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wawa, there are more and more of them...! 
What do I do, we ran out of vegetables...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
What's that?! Dotou, are you okay? That's 
so many animals!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I-I'm so sorry! They begged so nicely 
for the veggies that I gave them every 
last piece~!

text_block_list.name: Foreign BBQ Guest
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, what an incredible sight... It's just 
like something out of a fantasy movie!"

text_block_list.name: Foreign BBQ Guest
text_block_list.text:
"Young lady, would you mind letting us 
take a photo? You look just like a heroine 
playing with woodland creatures!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh, f-foreigners? Um... "I-If it's 
photos, please ask someone else 
instead..."

text_block_list.name: Foreign BBQ Guest
text_block_list.text:
"No, we want to capture you and the 
animals together! It'll make for a picture 
right out of a movie scene!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"M-Me, a model?! T-That's way too much 
honor for someone like meee~~~!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha! You'll be fine, Dotou. Don't be 
afraid. ――It's gonna turn out great.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Look, just be natural with these things! 
Loosen up and give 'em a smile. Right?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Stay-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-Okay, I'll try...! Um... peace sign...?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wawa, kitty cat... If you snuggle up that 
close, it tickles!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, they are very friendly, aren't 
they! You look just like a family with 
Dotou!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh? It's staring right at Taiki-san... 
Hehe, I bet this little one wants to be 
friends with you too, Taiki-san.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow, I am so happy! Then let me join the 
family circle too♪

text_block_list.name: Foreign BBQ Guest
text_block_list.text:
"Oh, you over there look wonderful as 
well! Let us get a photo of both of you!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Dotou, kitty, and goat too, let's all 
strike a pose together!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-A pose? Then, um... maybe like this...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh? It looks like the kitty wants to climb 
onto your back, Dotou!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? O-Okay! If you're okay with using me 
as a stepping stone...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Wawa, you're taking photos of this too? 
Kitty looks like it's totally relaxing up 
there, though...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, this is a great chance! Let's show 
everyone how close we all are!

text_block_list.name: Foreign BBQ Guest
text_block_list.text:
"Come, have some of our BBQ! Thanks to you 
girls, we got the best photos ever! 
Consider it our treat, eat up!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, what a huge piece of meat... B-But 
isn't it burnt pitch black...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Non, non, that is not burnt! That's 
authentic slow-smoked style. Inside, it's 
a total juicy meat paradise...!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahaha! Man, what an awesome day!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day after the holiday. Photos of the 
horse girls frolicking with animals had 
become a trending topic on social media, 
so I asked the girl herself about it.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so you saw the photos... I got to make 
so many animal friends... Ehehe, it was so 
much fun.
choice_data_list: You've become quite the celebrity, huh?
Did you get to eat a lot of BBQ?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so you saw the photos... I got to make 
so many animal friends... Ehehe, it was so 
much fun.
choice_data_list: You've become quite the celebrity, huh?
Did you get to eat a lot of BBQ?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-That surprised me too... I never 
imagined it would become such a big 
topic...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But... having people like me really 
makes me happy. I'm so grateful to 
everyone who made it possible...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yes, they treated us to plenty of 
delicious food. Not just food, but so much 
supportive cheer too.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
S-So I want to do my best... to return the 
favor as much as I can...!
